[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic3 = [[File:Zen Daijun explorable area southern village.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = Village on the southern mountain trail | pic4 = [[File:Zen Daijun Shrine of Zunraa.jpg|196px]] | pic4-text = Shrine of Zunraa | page name suffix=explorable area | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=246 }} [[Zen Daijun (explorable area)|Zen Daijun]] is a lush and tranquil valley long regarded as sacred or holy by the people of [[Cantha]]. It is watched over and protected from harm by the [[kirin]] [[Zunraa]]. == Getting there == The only way to reach this explorable area is to speak to [[Guard Lae Fao]] in [[Seitung Harbor]], after completing the [[Zen Daijun|Zen Daijun mission]]. ==Exits== *[[Seitung Harbor]] (west) ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: *[[Champion of Balthazar]] **South, inside [[Ghachu Cave]], nearer towards the eastern end. *[[Lyssa's Muse]] **West, at the exit into [[Seitung Harbor]]. *[[Melandru's Watcher]] **Southeast, close to the signpost at [[Kei Beach]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== * {{mo}} 13 (20) [[Zunraa]] (during [[An Unwelcome Guest]] or if summoned by a [[Shrine of Zunraa]]) ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s *{{x}} 3 [[Crane]] (around [[Tei Lake]]; either a Crane or Tiger will randomly [[spawn]] outside [[Seitung Harbor]]) *{{x}} 3 [[Tiger]] (just south of the exit into the [[Zen Daijun (outpost)|Zen Daijun outpost]]; either a Tiger or Crane will randomly spawn outside Seitung Harbor) ===Foes=== [[Afflicted]] *{{w}} 14 (24) [[Afflicted Warrior]] *{{r}} 14 (24) [[Afflicted Ranger]] *{{mo}} 14 (24) [[Afflicted Monk]] *{{n}} 14 (24) [[Afflicted Necromancer]] *{{me}} 10 (24) [[Afflicted Mesmer]] *{{e}} 10 (24) [[Afflicted Elementalist]] *{{a}} 14 (24) [[Afflicted Assassin]] *{{rt}} 12 (24) [[Afflicted Ritualist]] [[Kirin]] *{{mo}} 15 (25) [[Jade Torn Kirin (monk)|Jade Torn Kirin]] ==Points of interest== *[[Daijun Library]] *[[Ghachu Cave]] *[[Kahnju Overlook]] *[[Kei Beach]] *[[Tei Lake]] == Notes == {{gw2w|Zen Daijun}} * [[Zunraa]] can be summoned by using a [[Shrine of Zunraa]] and will follow your [[party]] as an ally. * There is a [[w:Komainu|Komainu]] guarding the passage towards Kahnju Overlook. *{{Vanquisher|count = 163|low = 160|high = 166}} ** Most of the afflicted groups contain an [[Afflicted Ritualist]]; prevention of their [[Spirit Transfer]] and [[Recuperation]] is recommended. ** [[Afflicted Ranger]]s, [[Afflicted Monk|Monks]], [[Afflicted Mesmer|Mesmers]] and [[Afflicted Elementalist|Elementalists]] are only found in two or three groups. ** [[Factions]] [[character]]s can vanquish this area by killing or [[Charm Animal|charming]] a single [[animal]]. This trick requires that all characters have completed [[An Unwelcome Guest]] and that [[Winds of Change]] is not active (either because the character has not started it or because [[Memories of Purity]] is active). It will not work if the party includes any [[Prophecies]] or [[Nightfall]] characters. This is an intended feature, rewarding Canthan natives for their role in clearing evil from the area. (Source: [http://guildwars.incgamers.com/forums/showthread.php?t=472233&page=4 Gaile Gray at Inc Gamers, in 2008] ''(Broken link)'') {{Explorable areas in Shing Jea Island}} [[de:Zen Daijun (Erforschbar)]]
